verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents peer-to-peer connections and lets you run your own rendezvous/relay server, so devices can connect without a vendor server. A long-time user also reports there is "no account BS" when using their own lookup/relay server. Nothing in the evidence shows local-network discovery of hosts or a server-less direct LAN/IP connection, and one user reported it couldn't connect directly by IP and seemed to require a relay server. missing for 10: documented LAN host discovery, documented direct-IP connection with no rendezvous server at all, first-party documentation that no account is needed.

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between

citations.quote: P2P connection with end-to-end encryption based on NaCl.
clients connect peer to peer when they can and fall back to your relay.
You can use our rendezvous/relay server, set up your own, or write your own rendezvous/relay server.
No need to open ports, no need for vpn, it just works, no account BS, no vendor lock in.
